Name: Anticipation
Effect: In battle, this Pokémon will warn of one Move/Maneuver that a Foe has that would deal Super Effective Damage to it. The first time that Move/Maneuver is used against this Pokémon, ignore all Damage and other effects from it.
Description: The Pokémon is always alert for threats and rarely sits to relax. If it perceives a potential danger it will get anxious and start shuddering.
